front.name: Kessig Forgemaster
clauses: Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked by a creature, this creature deals 1 damage to that creature.
At the beginning of each upkeep, if no spells were cast last turn, transform this creature.

back.name: Flameheart Werewolf
clauses: Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked by a creature, this creature deals 2 damage to that creature.
At the beginning of each upkeep, if a player cast two or more spells last turn, transform this creature.
